source.title: Ashenvale Mission XIII: Defeat Larsera
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Bough Shadow, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion in Forest Song. Defeat the dragon Larsera there and return to me.
source.objective: Defeat Larsera in the Ashenvale Nightmare Incursion outside the central ruin in Forest Song and return to Field Captain Hannalah.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
